questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 4 say about two compared to one?
options: Two are better than one, for they have a good reward for their toil
One is far better than two, for company together only breeds strife
The strong man stands at his very best when he stands entirely alone
Two may well begin a work together, but each one must end it all alone
questions.answer: Two are better than one, for they have a good reward for their toil

questions.question: What does the Preacher observe with sorrow in Ecclesiastes 4?
options: The tears of the oppressed who had no comforter
The laughter of fools, like thorns crackling under a pot
The rich man whose abundance permits him no sleep
The wise man who dies and is forgotten like the fool
questions.answer: The tears of the oppressed who had no comforter

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 4 says a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Two are better than _____, because they have a good reward for their toil.
A threefold cord is not quickly _____.
